scripts.build: bun run build:vault && bun run build:tax && bun run check:origin-isolation
scripts.test: bun run test:crypto && bun run test:maintenance && bun run test:tax && bun run test:worker
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json && tsc -p test/tsconfig.json
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build
scripts.cf:types: wrangler types worker-configuration.d.ts --env production --env-file /dev/null --env-interface CloudflareEnv --include-runtime false
scripts.pages-dev: bun run build:local && wrangler pages dev
scripts.pages-dev:tax: bun run build:tax && cd tax-site && wrangler pages dev dist --port 8789
scripts.deploy:tax: cd tax-site && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name 1pass-tax --branch main
